comments:
cdf4e98d: ;
 .;DGJXA12 is a utility to ask questions about a particular field.
 .;
 .;The DE and DU routines are used to set relevant values for fields.
 .;The W routine is used to write out the prompt for the user input.
 .;The O routine handles the display of responses.
 .;The TR routine reads in the user's input.
821a3a92: ;Call DE to set up field information, then go to BEGIN label.
f471ac2f: ;Set DIE to the global root, DIC same as DIE, DP=file#, DL=length of data, DIEL=0 means not word-processing field, DU="" sets nothing in DU. Quit if subfile entry is missing.
94ba57b6: ;If .01 field is defined, set DE(1) equal to the 4th piece (specifier).
870afd46: ;Kill %Z and quit.
8c88574f: ;Write the field prompt, based on DL (data length) and DLB (display logic block).
48ec4ac0: ;Quit (W is just to write the prompt string).
d2195fe5: ;Write out the response, handling new lines if response is longer than 45 chars.
9429ee2f: ;If response length >19 and DV logic doesn't allow word-wrapping, branch to RW^DIR2 to handle output.
72b33306: ;For fields where no editing is allowed, write "  (No Editing)" if DE(DQ) is defined.
703d6a81: ;Read user's response into X, set time for response, allow timeout by setting DTOUT=U if timeout.
ca4617eb: Quit the program
8a262a16: Increment the value of DQ and store it in DQ
bf5aad9e: Branch to the line label specified by the value of DQ
2edd0e4e: If the DE array contains an entry for the current value of DQ, go to the PR label, otherwise execute the W and TR lines
c245d873: If X is empty and DV does not contain 'R', go to A. If X is non-empty and DV is empty, go to X. If X is non-empty and D is negative or 0, go to X. Otherwise, go to A
0f7cb744: If X starts with '?', go to QS. If X contains '^', execute D and go to the label ^DIE17
721367ca: If X is '@', execute D and go to the label Z^DIE2
575b3d2c: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and the DUZ user has a value in ^DISV('DIE',DLB), set X to that value. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write 'X' preceded by two spaces

5e410f84: If DV is not empty, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', go to P. If the DD array for the current file and field contains a value at the 12.1 node, execute that code. Set % to the portion of DU after the semicolon and before the first occurrence of X followed by a colon. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and the DIC('S') code exists, execute it. If the result is true and DB(DQ) does not exist, write '% ' preceded by two spaces, then go to V
972c2fc3: ;Call input transform if defined
f1beb8e2: ;Write out any leading portion not contained in the colon-delimited string
49f29e62: ;If value is pointer, look it up
159aaf29: ;If value is numeric, check for valid number
bfc21568: ;Strip off trailing 0s after decimal point
cc2270ec: ;Kill the zero node subscript of YS and execute code segment 'X'.

b19ca783: ;Clear screen variable DIC('S') and set DLAYGO to null. If X is defined and not equal to up-arrow, store X in the DG array at subscript DW, and set ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB) to X if DV contains 'd'. Then execute the A code segment.
d7fc9fb6: ;Emit a beep and question marks if DB(DQ) is defined, then go to the Z^DIE17 code segment.
38286b0e: Set the input X to '?BAD' which is an invalid value.
58bb488b: Set up variables and call the D and QQ^DIEQ subroutines. If the execution reaches the label B, it will branch back here.

36b24074: This is the definition of the D label (subroutine). It sets up variables related to fields and their properties, and constructs a portion of the code for the DQ array based on the input field DIFLD.

029fb094: This is the definition of the Y label (subroutine). It checks if the DE(DQ) array is defined. If not, it calls the O subroutine and branches to RD if X does not equal '@', or to A if DV does not contain 'R' and X equals '@', or to X if X equals '@'. It then sets X to Y and goes to the N label.
79d8d429: Call next line tag if defined
56434e96: If field is a pointer and pointed to file exists, get value from pointed to file
f5319968: If field is a multivalued pointer and multivalued global exists, get value from pointed to file
65f0f45c: For Data Dictionaries and SubFiles, set Y to piece from X
a70255b8: ;Call DIE17^DIE17 if value passed is not new or if cross-referenced field.
57c578ce: ;If not input transform and not DINUM, go to RD.
96811fef: ;If an input transform exists and succeeds, go to RD, else go to PR.
1435f373: ;Quit if failed input transform.
4b0689ff: ;Set variables used in validation.
b1eea480: ;Set variables used in RE logic and field properties.
39e33f6b: ;Go to RE logic code.
4b094fa4: ;Dummy label to prevent falling into next section of code.
98d38f73: ;Call input transform and validation code if defined. If value defined after transform, set X and go to output transform.
dfdbdbc9: If X is empty, set the 3rd piece of the 'DT' node to empty, set DGJTST to 'DICTATED', and set Y to '@2'.
3462595a: Quit routine.

57cbe2c1: If DG is defined, execute F^DIE17 and set Y to undefined character, set DQ to 3, execute X3, go to label A if Y is undefined or Y is undefined character. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to DQ, and go to OUT^DIE17.
d96c0149: Set DGJTST to 'TRANSCRIBED'.
3f67c39b: Quit routine.
3798b1f1: If DG is defined, execute F^DIE17, then go to ^DGJXA13.
